title: JoasASantos/REA-Prompts
why_read: A prompt collection for using an LLM to reverse engineer or analyze arbitrary programs, interesting as a prompt-engineering resource but lacking deep novel technical content itself.
analysis: This repository provides a curated set of prompts intended to help someone use a large language model to reverse engineer or break down the logic of any given program. It's essentially a prompt-engineering toolkit rather than a tool with its own executable logic, so its value depends entirely on the underlying LLM's actual reverse-engineering capability. The project could be useful as a quick-start guide for AI-assisted code analysis, but it isn't a rigorous technical contribution itself.
